description: This Java source file defines the EventBusAuthenticationService class, which implements an authentication service that communicates via Vert.x Event Bus to verify credentials, and includes an inner class HonoUserImpl that wraps JWT tokens and user authorities.

classes.name: EventBusAuthenticationService
classes.description: A final class implementing an authentication service that sends auth requests over Vert.x Event Bus and processes JWT tokens.

classes.name: HonoUserImpl
classes.description: Inner static class implementing HonoUser, wrapping a JWT token and user authorities, with expiration handling.

methods.name: EventBusAuthenticationService
methods.description: Constructor initializing Vertx environment and token validator.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication by sending request over Event Bus, handling reply, and creating HonoUser.

methods.name: HonoUserImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing user token, authorities, and claims.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the subject (name) from the JWT token.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the raw JWT token string.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token is expired, considering a leeway period.

methods.name: getExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns the token's expiration time as Instant.
